item.title: Egor Demin sets NBA rookie 3-point record as Nets snap 7-game skid with 109-99 win over Jazz
item.description: SALT LAKE CITY (AP) — Egor Demin set an NBA rookie record by making a 3-pointer in his 34th straight game and finished with 25 points and 10 rebounds to help the Brooklyn Nets snap a seven-game losing streak with a 109-99 victory over the Utah Jazz on Friday night. item.title: Grand Canyon wins 86-69 over Boise State
item.description: PHOENIX (AP) — Jaden Henley scored 20 points as Grand Canyon beat Boise State 86-69 on Friday night. item.title: At least 200 killed in coltan mine collapse in eastern Congo, rebel authorities say
item.description: GOMA, Congo (AP) — At least 200 people were killed earlier this week when a landslide collapsed several mines at a major coltan mining site in eastern Congo, rebel authorities said Saturday. item.description: SAN FRANCISCO (AP) — Stephen Curry has been bothered by a sore right knee over the past week and the injury limited him to three quarters in the Golden State Warriors’ 131-124 loss to the Detroit Pistons on Friday night.
